name: brucelee-vita
description: Unofficial PS Vita port of Bruce Lee: Dragon Warrior (Android). Loader-only; game data not included.
long_description: Unofficial port of the Android game **Bruce Lee: Dragon Warrior** (Digital Legends / Sony Ericsson / Indiagames, v1.15.26, `armeabi`) to the **PS Vita**, using vitaGL and the `so_util`/FalsoJNI ecosystem.
